title: Create paginated API endpoint for external tasking history
userStory: As a developer, I want a single API endpoint that returns paginated claude-code jobs so that the frontend can efficiently fetch and display filtered results.
acceptanceCriteria: Supports query params: page, pageSize, status[], workspaceId, startDate, endDate
Returns { items: Job[], total: number, page: number, pageSize: number, totalPages: number }
Filters to only claude-code job type
Includes currently processing job in response metadata: { currentJob: Job | null }
